```python
import json
from collections import Counter

words = (
    "randolph wand hardhat coates shortcake pent paddy inferring peril "
    "woodstock withdraw lepidopterist aryl tropopause disputant vermiculite"
).split()

def letter_claims(claims, position):
    return all(
        len(word) > position
        and word[position] == letter
        and ord(letter) - ord("a") + 1 == number
        for word, letter, number in claims
    )

def valid_groups(groups):
    flat = [word for group in groups for word in group]
    if Counter(flat) != Counter(words):
        return False
    return all(
        left < right
        for i, group in enumerate(groups)
        for later in groups[i + 1:]
        for left in group
        for right in later
    )

prefix = [[w] for w in
          ["aryl", "coates", "disputant", "hardhat", "inferring", "lepidopterist"]]
middle = [[w] for w in
          ["randolph", "shortcake", "tropopause", "vermiculite"]]
w_group = [["wand", "woodstock", "withdraw"]]

checks = [
    letter_claims([
        ("randolph", "r", 18), ("wand", "w", 23),
        ("hardhat", "h", 8), ("coates", "c", 3),
        ("shortcake", "s", 19), ("pent", "p", 16),
        ("paddy", "p", 16), ("inferring", "i", 9),
        ("peril", "p", 16), ("woodstock", "w", 23),
        ("withdraw", "w", 23), ("lepidopterist", "l", 12),
        ("aryl", "a", 1), ("tropopause", "t", 20),
        ("disputant", "d", 4), ("vermiculite", "v", 22)
    ], 0),
    valid_groups(prefix + [["pent", "paddy", "peril"]] + middle + w_group),
    letter_claims([
        ("pent", "e", 5), ("paddy", "a", 1), ("peril", "e", 5)
    ], 1),
    valid_groups(prefix + [["paddy"], ["pent", "peril"]] + middle + w_group),
    letter_claims([("pent", "n", 14), ("peril", "r", 18)], 2),
    valid_groups(prefix + [["paddy"], ["pent"], ["peril"]] + middle + w_group),
    letter_claims([
        ("wand", "a", 1), ("woodstock", "o", 15), ("withdraw", "i", 9)
    ], 1),
    valid_groups(
        prefix + [["paddy"], ["pent"], ["peril"]] + middle
        + [["wand"], ["withdraw"], ["woodstock"]]
    ),
    (
        "aryl coates disputant hardhat inferring lepidopterist paddy pent "
        "peril randolph shortcake tropopause vermiculite wand withdraw woodstock"
    ).split() == sorted(words)
]

first_error = next((i for i, valid in enumerate(checks, 1) if not valid), None)
print(json.dumps({
    "final_answer": "No" if first_error is None else str(first_error),
    "evidence": {
        "thought_checks": checks,
        "computed_order": sorted(words)
    }
}, separators=(",", ":")))
```
